observations: Blue and black high-pressure water machine.
Power cord is coiled around the body.
Power switch and control panel are visible on the front.
The machine is resting on a light-colored wooden surface.
A watermark 'DANCOFFICE TEXTURES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance

risks.risk: The internal pump may be leaking or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine successfully pressurizing water through a hose.

risks.risk: The electrical cord may be damaged or have a faulty plug.
risks.proof: A photo of the plug and the entire cord laid out.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing its own power supply or accessories.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with its power adapter and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: as missing its own power supply

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine running and spraying water.
Photo of the power plug and the full length of the cord.
Photo of the machine with its power adapter and any other included parts.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
